how_to_apply: Register and apply on the Online Application Portal of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways at MoPSW Online Application Portal.
Take a printout of the filled application. Paste a recent passport size photograph in the right-hand corner.
Attach self-attested copies of your education, experience and age certificates, along with the documents listed below.

Send the application through proper channel so that it reaches this address on or before 7 December 2026: The Secretary, Deendayal Port Authority, Administrative Office Building, Gandhidham – Kutch, Gujarat - 370201.
If any major or minor penalty was imposed on you in the last 10 years, your forwarding authority may send the disciplinary case and its documents with the application.

content_sections.heading: About Deendayal Port Authority
content_sections.text: Deendayal Port Authority, formerly Deendayal Port Trust, is a Major Port Authority. This circular was issued by its General Administration Department, Administration Office Building, Post Box No. 50, Gandhidham (Kutch), Gujarat. The letter is addressed to the Secretaries of all Major Port Authorities, because the post is open only to their officers.

content_sections.heading: Deendayal Port Deputy Chief Engineer Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The Recruitment Rule in Annexure I gives the number of posts as 2 in its "No. of posts" column. It also sets the order of recruitment: absorption through the composite method first, then deputation from other Government organisations if that fails, and direct recruitment if both fail. content_sections.heading: Deendayal Port Deputy Chief Engineer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Crucial date: eligibility is judged on the last date of online submission, 27 November 2026. Age limit: the Recruitment Rule sets an upper age limit of 42 years for direct recruitment. It also says that this age limit does not apply to absorption or deputation. Educational qualification (applies to absorption): a degree or equivalent in Civil Engg. from a recognized university/institution. Who can apply for absorption through the composite method: Officers holding analogous posts, or Superintending Engineer and equivalent posts in the Civil Engg. Department, in the scale of pay of Rs. 13000-18250, with three years' service in the grade in a Major Port Trust, or Superintending Engineer and equivalent posts in the Civil Engineering Department, with two years' service in the grade and a combined service of seven years in the scales of Rs. 10750-16750 and Rs. 13000-18250, in the Civil Engineering Department of a Major Port Trust. Experience: the Recruitment Rule asks direct recruits for twelve years' experience in the executive cadre in Planning/Construction/Design/Maintenance, preferably of Port and Marine Structure, in an Industrial/Commercial/Govt. Undertaking. It also says this experience requirement does not apply to absorption. Deputation (only if absorption fails): officers holding analogous posts, or Superintending Engineer and equivalent posts in the Civil Engineering Department in the scale of Rs. 13000-18250 with three years' service in the grade, in Govt./PSUs/Autonomous bodies. Check the Recruitment Rule in Annexure I of the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by merit. The overall grading in the ACRs must be at least "very good". As conveyed by the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways in its letter dated 29.12.2020, the DPC for Dy. HoD level posts may be held at port level. The port sends the DPC's recommendations to the Ministry for approval before it issues appointment orders.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The post is Class I and a Selection post. The Recruitment Rule gives the period of probation as NA. An officer who withdraws after being selected can be barred from selection to any post in Deendayal Port Authority for two (02) years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Deendayal Port Deputy Chief Engineer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Register and apply on the Online Application Portal of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways at MoPSW Online Application Portal . Take a printout of the filled application. Paste a recent passport size photograph in the right-hand corner. Attach self-attested copies of your education, experience and age certificates, along with the documents listed below. Send the application through proper channel so that it reaches this address on or before 7 December 2026: The Secretary, Deendayal Port Authority, Administrative Office Building, Gandhidham – Kutch, Gujarat - 370201. If any major or minor penalty was imposed on you in the last 10 years, your forwarding authority may send the disciplinary case and its documents with the application. Documents to attach: Attested copies of APARs/ACRs for the last 5 years. An officer not below the rank of Dy. HoD must attest each page. For any year without an APAR/ACR, send a "No Report Certificate" with the APARs/ACRs of the earlier years. Attested copies of certificates and proof of educational qualification, and of present and past work experience in the post and pay scale. No-objection certificate from your port. An undertaking that you will not withdraw if selected. A certificate from your Head of Office (Annexure II). It confirms that your particulars are correct, that no disciplinary or vigilance case is pending or contemplated, that your integrity is certified and that no major or minor penalty was imposed in the last 10 years. It also encloses your ACRs from 01.04.2021 to 31.03.2026. Vigilance/Administrative clearance from your port in the Ministry's proforma (Annexure III). Part A is filled in by the HoD and covers details such as penalties, pending proceedings and immovable property returns under Rule 15 (3) of the KPE (Conduct) Regulations, 1964. Part B is filled in by the CVO. Applications that are incomplete, arrive after the due date or do not come through proper channel will not be considered. The management reserves the right to make changes without giving a reason.

faq.question: Q1. Who can apply for the Deendayal Port Deputy Chief Engineer post?
faq.answer: Only eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities can apply. They must hold an analogous post or a Superintending Engineer or equivalent post in the Civil Engineering Department, with the service set out in the Recruitment Rule.

faq.question: Q2. What is the pay scale?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 80,000 to Rs. 2,20,000. The pre-revised scale was Rs. 16,000 to Rs. 20,800.

faq.question: Q3. Is there an age limit for absorption?
faq.answer: No. The upper age limit of 42 years applies only to direct recruitment. The Recruitment Rule says it does not apply to absorption.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed?
faq.answer: You need a degree or equivalent in Civil Engg. from a recognized university/institution. This requirement also applies to absorption.

faq.question: Q5. How much service do I need as Superintending Engineer?
faq.answer: You need three years in the Rs. 13000-18250 grade in a Major Port Trust. Two years in that grade also qualifies if you have a combined seven years in the Rs. 10750-16750 and Rs. 13000-18250 scales.

faq.question: Q6. What ACR grading is required?
faq.answer: Your overall ACR grading must be at least "very good". You must send APARs/ACRs for the last 5 years, with each page attested by an officer not below Dy. HoD rank.

faq.question: Q7. Where do I send the hard copy?
faq.answer: Send it to The Secretary, Deendayal Port Authority, Administrative Office Building, Gandhidham – Kutch, Gujarat - 370201. It must reach there by 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Which annexures must go with the application?
faq.answer: Annexure II is the Head of Office certificate. Annexure III is the vigilance clearance proforma, with Part A signed by the HoD and Part B by the CVO.

faq.question: Q9. What happens if I withdraw after selection?
faq.answer: You can be barred from selection to any post in Deendayal Port Authority for two (02) years.

faq.question: Q10. Who approves the final appointment?
faq.answer: The DPC may be held at port level. Its recommendations go to the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways for approval before the appointment order is issued.
